question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"lunged"**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lunge ** (आक्रमण करना) refers** to making a sudden forward thrust with (a part of the body or a weapon)**.

 
 
• **Example - ***Billy **lunged **his spear at the fish.*
 
 
 
• The sentence implies that the **creature** then **lunged across** the **cellar** in her direction.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

Correct Paragraph__: *The thing nodded vigorously; as it nodded, the left button-eye fell off and (1) __clattered__ (2) __on to__ the concrete floor. The thing looked around (3) *__vacantly__ *with its one eye, as if it had lost her. The thing twisted bonelessly (4) __until__ its one eye was again facing her. And it **(5) __lunged__** across the cellar towards her then.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hung (लटकना)** - Suspended something so that it does not touch the ground.

 
 
• **Example**: She hung the picture on the wall.
 
 
 
• **Rung (बजा दिया)** - The past participle of 'ring', typically referring to a bell.
 
 
• **Example**: He rung the doorbell and waited for a response.
 
 
 
• **Flung (फेंका हुआ)** - Thrown or hurled forcefully.
 
 
• **Example**: He flung the letter into the fire in anger.
